bluf: The United States conducted strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island ahead of US midterm elections; France 24 reported that a US official described strikes in the Strait of Hormuz as defensive. BBC News World reported that Kyiv attributed 31 deaths at a Ukraine aid centre to Russian bombing. BBC News World also reported cyber-attacks affecting supermarket freezers in 10 countries, with retailers forced to discard food.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that a 3AM ransomware affiliate targeted a UK school estate, encrypting around 37 of nearly 50 machines reached from an unmanaged host. AI assistance was described as suspected. The account is uncorroborated within the packet, and event timing was not stated.

The Record reported that a BYOD gang post appeared to align with a security incident prompting campus-wide action at Michigan State University. The connection remains uncorroborated within the packet, and incident timing was not stated.

items.text: The United States conducted strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island ahead of US midterm elections. BBC News World reported that US officials described the attacks as limited and defensive; France 24 reported an official's description of defensive strikes on Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz. Exact strike timing was not established.

BBC News World reported that Kyiv attributed 31 deaths at a Ukraine aid centre to Russian bombing, while officials said at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village. The account is uncorroborated within the packet, and event timing was not stated.

BBC News World reported cyber-attacks affecting supermarket freezers in 10 countries, with problems reported from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and retailers forced to discard food. The account is uncorroborated within the packet, and event timing was not stated.

Al Jazeera reported that renewed Russian and Ukrainian attacks on Black Sea shipping threaten grain exports, drive up food prices and deepen food insecurity. The account is uncorroborated within the packet, and event timing was not stated.

France 24 reported that students blockaded dozens of high schools across France on Tuesday over education reforms, as trade unions prepared for a nationwide strike later this week. The account is uncorroborated within the packet.
